title: Improvement of flame retardancy of poly(lactic acid) nonwoven fabric with a phosphorus-containing flame retardant
source_publication_date: First published online 8 September 2015; 2016 volume46 issue3 pages914–928
source_material_form_TGA_raw: PLA fabrics; each sample controlled to 4–5 mg in primary weight; no further TG specimen preparation stated
source_material_form_LOI_raw: PLA nonwoven fabric tested with FTT0080 oxygen index apparatus; specimen geometry not reported
LOI_instrument: FTT0080 oxygen index apparatus, Fire Testing Technology Ltd.
source_location: Publisher original Materials and methods/Fabric treatment and Measurements; Results/Flammability test paragraphs2 and5; Table 2 TG data; SEM/EDS paragraph2
TG_source_location: Original Table 2 and TG analysis paragraph1; T5/T10/T50 explicitly defined by mass-loss thresholds, Tmax by maximum thermal decomposition rate
LOI_source_location: Original Flammability test: untreated 26.3%; 200 g/L at 125 °C35.5%; Figure 2 caption fixes concentration series cure 125 °C
method_source_location: Original Fabric treatment and Measurements: PLA-0/100/200 definitions; TG30–600 °C, nitrogen 20 mL/min,10 °C/min,4–5 mg; LOI ASTM D2863/FTT0080
pairing_evidence: Original Fabric treatment explicitly defines PLA-0, PLA-100 and PLA-200 as fabrics at 0,100,200 g/L DP-150 cured125 °C. Own Flammability paragraphs give the reference 26.3 and200 g/L35.5; Table 2 assigns TG values to the exact PLA-0/PLA-200 labels. All come from the same sole melt-blown80 g/m² PLA nonwoven preparation.
limitations: Publisher original HTML text and numeric table/prose only; no PDF-byte hash or pixel claim. LOI specimen dimensions, repeats and statistical uncertainty, TG pan and extra conditioning are unreported. Oven60 °C30 min is reported for weight-gain weighing only and is not assigned as TG/LOI conditioning. Qualitative no/very-small char descriptions are not numerical residue; no zero or fixed-temperature residue inferred. MCC Tmax and EDS phosphorus are excluded from TG fields. DP-150 neat agent has no matching textile LOI. Source says four cure temperatures while listing five; exact125 °C adopted only where explicitly assigned. No durability wash series or washed-state transfer. Earlier differently prepared PLA literature is not borrowed; future same-source or same-family control reuse requires audit.
sample_state: PLA-0, source-defined 0 g/L DP-150 preparation at 125 °C
treatment_method: Source reference PLA-0: Fabric treatment defines0 g/L DP-150 and cure 125 °C; later prose calls it untreated. Exact water-padding/preparatory-rinse handling of this control is not separately clarified.
washing_state: Source PLA-0 reference; control preparation rinse not separately clarified; no durability washing assigned
